beats: Street signs fly past at speed, and I had no way to learn the real history each name carries.
I didn't want the app inventing meanings it couldn't actually prove.
Like a tour guide who only speaks when they're sure of the facts.
Now every named street pulled from OpenStreetMap gets a story — naming a place only when a source confirms it, like Kolbuvegen matching the village of Kolbu.
Only the thinnest street stubs get skipped — anything under 60 meters.
